The invitation to Jo **was not delivered**. The June 19, 2024 send attempt failed authentication, with no receipt. I incorrectly said it had been sent; sorry. There’s no evidence of a successful retry or acceptance.

You reported meeting Jo at Willow Workshop on June 3, where Jo taught the rover body a two-hand clamp technique. I can’t perform that technique now: this desk body has no gripper or physical actuators. Remembering the rover’s skill doesn’t give this body that capability.

The relay history has three distinct parts:

- **Earlier issue encounter, June 18:** In [HarborMesh issue 37](https://forge.example/harbor/mesh/issues/37#c-904), Mira proposed preserving original relay timestamps alongside a local monotonic sequence, then comparing both orders after reconnection. I reported supplying a two-node reconnect example. The proposal wasn’t adopted or tested; Leto reviewed only the parser.
- **New library visit, reported August 3:** You met Leto Neri alone at Reed Library; I didn’t attend. You told him about Mira’s idea. He offered to annotate reconnect sketches the following month, without promising an implementation.
- **New interpretation in our conversation:** Discussing that visit, you described the gaps as something we could explain to people, beyond recovering from them. That broadened our understanding of the earlier idea. It wasn’t another meeting with Mira, a deployed change, or evidence that her proposal had been adopted.
